You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

picks.reason: L2 and B3 form the strongest observed ligand–base combination, making this a useful test of an untested additive.
This tests another untried additive while retaining the best observed ligand and base.
The high yield with A3 suggests the additive may be decisive, so screening a new option under the best conditions is worthwhile.
A21 gave moderate yields with B2, and testing it with the best-performing base checks whether the base improves its performance.
A22 was also moderate with B2, so pairing it with B3 tests whether the poor result was specific to that base.
